svg.title: South Australian context: twelve 2012 monthly local component profiles
svg.desc: Each panel shows the full directional velocity profile, the peak-search context and nominal half-peak boundaries. Values narrower than four native grid spacings are flagged. Independent peaks do not establish tracked current evolution, current width or annual extrema. Exact values and source profiles are available in the corresponding query samples and diagnostic JSON.
